newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates up in Sunday market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates up in Sunday market.

text.p: Egyptian pound overnight interbank rates rose on Sunday to 10-1/4 percent from 9-7/8 percent on Thursday but the private sector market was not as short as usual, bankers said.
The market is normally short on Sunday, the beginning of the banking week.
One week rates were also higher at between 10 and 10-1/4 percent from 9-3/4 to 10-1/8 percent on Thursday.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
